summary.caption: A plain white background with soft, even studio lighting and no other objects. Three adult women stand side by side in a row, full body, posing for a cheerful unit portrait in matching colour-coded phantom-thief stage costumes.

items.label: object

Her waist is moderately thick and sturdy. She has enormous oversized breasts, far larger than natural, heavy and round. She wears a glossy sleeveless vivid pink phantom-thief stage costume: a vivid pink catsuit with a front zipper with a ring pull, an oval cutout at the side of the waist showing skin, a wide black belt with a silver heart-shaped buckle, a small black pouch on the belt, black long detached gloves, a short flared vivid pink skirt panel with black lace-up sides over the hips, and black thigh-high boots. She stands in a confident lineup pose with a bright energetic smile.
